findings.defect: The draft turns the narrator’s disbelieving hope that his fear was unfounded into confident prior suspicion.
findings.rationale: 설마 conveys incredulity or the hope that an alarming possibility cannot be true; the following sentence then confirms that his unease was correct.
findings.replacement: I’d thought there was no way.

findings.current: I gave a bitter smile and firmly grasped the hand he held out.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the narrator’s bitter lip-smacking gesture with a smile.
findings.rationale: 입맛을 다시며 describes smacking or working one’s lips, not smiling; this changes the stated physical action.
findings.replacement: I smacked my lips bitterly and firmly grasped the hand he held out.
findings.source: 나는 씁쓸한 입맛을 다시며 그가 내민 손을 굳게 맞잡았다.

findings.defect: The localized response changes the source’s blunt negation and weakens the deadpan callback to the question.
findings.rationale: 전혀요 directly means “Not at all,” which preserves the terse, dry response to whether they have been well.

findings.current: “It’s a barrier. It’s so discreet that even most S-rank Hunters wouldn’t notice it—and that’s precisely what makes it so perfect.”
findings.defect: The draft introduces a causal claim that the barrier’s secrecy is what makes it perfect, rather than describing secrecy and perfection as corresponding qualities.
findings.rationale: 그만큼 correlates the barrier’s degree of perfection with how well concealed it is; it does not explicitly state that concealment causes its perfection.
findings.replacement: “It’s a barrier. It’s hidden well enough to escape even most S-rank Hunters’ notice, and it’s every bit as flawless.”
findings.source: “결계야. 어지간한 S급 헌터조차 눈치채지 못할 만큼 비밀스럽고, 그만큼 완벽하지.”

findings.current: Although it had fallen in the rankings several years ago and now occupied the bottom position, the Wizard Guild had once been one of the world’s ten greatest Guilds.
findings.defect: The draft says the Wizard Guild currently occupies the bottom position, whereas the source says it was pushed out of the rankings years ago and had formerly held the last top-ten position.
findings.rationale: 순위에서 밀려난 indicates removal from the ranking, while 말석 describes its former bottom-place standing within the top ten.
findings.replacement: Although it had been pushed out of the rankings several years ago, the Wizard Guild had once been one of the world’s top ten Guilds, even if only in last place.
findings.source: 비록 이미 몇 년 전 평가 순위에서 밀려난 데다, 말석이라고는 하나 위저드 길드라면 과거의 세계 10대 길드 중 하나.

findings.current: “This body will kill that creature called the Prophet without fail.”
findings.defect: The draft identifies the Prophet as a creature, although 놈 is merely a contemptuous reference to a person or adversary.
findings.rationale: 놈 supplies contempt, not a nonhuman identity; the surrounding narration explicitly treats the perpetrators as human.
findings.replacement: “This body will kill that bastard called the Prophet without fail.”
findings.source: “이 몸이 선지자라는 놈을 반드시 죽여 없앨 것이다.”

findings.current: More than several thousand people were already dead, and more than ten times that number had been injured.
findings.defect: “More than several thousand” is an unnatural and needlessly overdetermined English quantity.
findings.rationale: 수천이 넘는 conveys a death toll in the thousands, while the replacement retains the explicit statement that the injured exceed ten times that number.
findings.replacement: Thousands of people had already died, and more than ten times as many had been injured.
findings.source: 벌써 수천이 넘는 사람들이 죽었고, 그 열 배가 넘는 사람들이 다쳤다.

findings.current: Along with the ten terrorist attacks accompanied by Monster Waves, the mana distribution grew even steeper, and mutation Gate phenomena were now occurring dozens of times a day.
findings.defect: A distribution cannot idiomatically “grow steeper”; the draft calques the Korean rate-of-increase expression.
findings.rationale: 더욱 가파르게 증가 describes an increasingly steep rise, not the distribution itself becoming geometrically steeper.
findings.replacement: Along with the ten terrorist attacks accompanied by Monster Waves, the mana distribution continued to rise at an even steeper rate, and mutation Gate phenomena were now occurring dozens of times a day.
findings.source: 몬스터 웨이브를 동반한 열 번의 테러와 함께 마력 분포도는 더욱 가파르게 증가했고, 이제는 하루에도 수십 번씩 변이 게이트 현상이 발생하고 있었다.

findings.current: *The thread connecting me to one of them was severed so pointlessly.*
findings.defect: The draft adds the unsupported assertion that the thread was specifically connected to the narrator and renders 허무하게 as purposeless rather than abruptly or anticlimactically lost.
findings.rationale: The source leaves the thread’s owner unstated and emphasizes how futile or anticlimactic its sudden loss was.
findings.replacement: *The thread leading to one of them had been severed just like that.*
findings.source: ‘그중 하나와 연결된 실이 허무하게 끊겼다는 거지.’

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it alters two physical or factual details, loses several pragmatic nuances, and contains a few localized terminology and English issues.
